description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (in percentage) of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score ranging from 60% to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. Each dataset has four grouped bars, corresponding to: MADLLM (green), MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), MADLLM without prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM without skip embedding (orange), as indicated in the legend below the chart. On SMD, all variants perform similarly, with scores around 91–93%. On PSM, the full MADLLM achieves the highest score (~97%), while removing the prompt pool drops performance to ~77%. On SWaT, MADLLM scores ~91%, and removing prompt pool reduces it to ~83%. For SMAP, MADLLM scores ~93%, but removing feature embedding or prompt pool reduces performance to ~69–70%. On MSL, MADLLM scores ~87%, and removing prompt pool drops it to ~69%. On WADI, MADLLM scores ~74%, while all ablated versions perform significantly worse (~62–64%). The chart visually emphasizes the importance of each component, particularly the prompt pool and feature embedding, whose removal leads to substantial performance degradation on most datasets.
